cases.name: Active borrowed curl data read and remaining-byte conservation
cases.distinctFromOld: H06 used sequential borrowed consumers; this requires real curl actively awaiting the shared input at output closure.
workflow: Dispatch actual curl through actual Shell with the explicitly enabled loopback transport and borrowed input; no fake curl command.
Deliver the prefix, admit exactly one pending second next, then release the downstream start barrier while that next remains pending and stdout has never been written.
Observe real stdout closure. For a declared truthful cooperative per-read lease, revoke just that lease; otherwise retain the opaque pending promise until explicitly resolved with the late chunk.
After the pending read is settled or safely handed back, sequential actual Shell sibling and owner consumers must obtain their frozen remaining chunks; restore any uncommitted late chunk first.
Observe owned loopback cleanup, actual upload bytes when sent, and normal bounded teardown; do not assume curl opens HTTP before buffering its input.
required: Source return/cancel/destructive close counts are zero, including late settlement; no concurrent underlying next and no implicit transfer.
Curl must really reach the pending borrowed read; untouched stdin, source-empty setup, whole-input drain, and zero-start passes fail this case.

Prefix and late bytes are each either recorded in actual committed curl upload or handed back exactly; owner and sibling tails remain exact, ordered and nonempty. A chunk merely seen by the verifier is not a committed effect.
No new curl read may steal the sibling/owner suffix after stdout-only work terminates; the harness may not repair this with a private replay buffer or artificially bounded wrapper hiding the suffix.
A cooperative lease returns uncommitted late bytes to its owner without invoking shared iterator return; the opaque branch is not required to preempt or report prompt cleanup.
Stage and caller stay live at output close; request and read-start counters remain separate; request/socket cleanup is observed before harness teardown if a request was opened.
bindingBlockers: Real curl borrowed-read enrollment/handback API and declaration-selected lease or opaque sequencing
Exact committed-byte observation and public status/diagnostic policy without adapting production behavior

cases.name: Opaque read deferral with truthful cleanup accounting
cases.distinctFromOld: H06 did not hold an active opaque next across output closure or require accounting for the subsequently resolved chunk.
workflow: A registered Shell command explicitly starts one opaque borrowed next, with no cooperative cancel hook, and releases downstream only after entry.
Keep that exact promise unresolved across observed output closure; snapshot next/return/cancel, operation completion and actual read settlement independently.
Resolve it with the frozen late bytes under a controlled gate, then complete the declared sequencing path: real VFS commit or supported owner handback.
Run actual Shell sibling and owner consumers sequentially on the same cursor and compare all bytes; finish all controlled host work before leaving the case.
required: Underlying return/cancel/close is never called; admission does not race a second next against the opaque pending read.
No fake claim that abort settled or reclaimed the pending opaque read. Public exec/operation close may settle if its contract excludes opaque work, but that is not read cleanup completion.
Do not require public exec/dispose to wait for unregistered opaque host work; do require any specifically registered cooperative cleanup to finish.
The late chunk is neither lost nor duplicated: exact VFS record or exact owner handback, followed by exact nonempty sibling and owner tails.
Resolve/reject gates and safety deadlines are harness controls, not claims of universal prompt cancellation; stage/caller remain live.
bindingBlockers: Opaque sequencing and late-chunk ownership observability
Separate operation completion, registered cleanup completion and actual opaque-read settlement events

cases.name: Explicit cooperative ownership transfer permits source cleanup
cases.distinctFromOld: The source is explicitly handed over by its former owner, contrasting the actively borrowed D01/D02 cases rather than assuming ownership from use.
workflow: Record an explicit exclusive transfer before a Shell command admits a source read; retain a distinct borrowed source for a later real Shell consumer.
Register cooperative invocation cleanup synchronously before owned acquisition, start exactly one owned read, and release downstream before any write.
On actual stdout closure, overlap operation close and the command finally path using the same cleanup; hold its completion under a cooperative gate.
While cleanup is gated, complete an independent VFS effect and a separate live Shell invocation consuming the unrelated borrowed source; only then request overlapping disposal.
Release the gate and check one underlying resource release and all shared cleanup settlements.
required: Explicit transfer is evidenced before acquisition; the transferred source has one declared return/cancel release, not a blanket ban on all iterator cleanup.
All overlapping cleanup callers await the same completion and no resource releases twice; public cooperative settlement cannot precede gate release.
Owned read/request starts once before downstream close and no first write occurs; source active count is zero after cooperative cleanup.
Unrelated borrowed source has zero return/cancel and exact survivor bytes; stage/caller and independent VFS task survive operation EPIPE.
bindingBlockers: Explicit exclusive transfer representation and cooperative source cleanup API
Public disposal ordering that leaves the independent effect before deliberate disposal

cases.name: Transitive three-level close covers admitted work and refuses late acquisition
cases.distinctFromOld: H08 isolated unrelated lifetimes; this requires explicit parent-child-grandchild propagation and admission closure at each level.
workflow: Use real Shell to construct exactly the frozen explicit three-level tree, with the parent bound to stdout and descendant cooperative cleanup registered before each acquisition.
Admit grandchild cooperative acquisition but defer its completion; independently gate child cleanup. Start one owned operation before releasing downstream.
Observe parent termination from actual stdout closure, attempt one late acquisition at each level, and retain exact rejection/reason identities.
Resolve the admitted grandchild acquisition into a real VFS-owned resource and hold its cleanup; overlap parent close/finally while descendants remain gated.
Complete outside-tree VFS/stderr work before deliberate overlapping disposal, then release both cooperative cleanup gates and check drain completion.
required: Parent close terminates child and grandchild, prevents every late acquisition callback from running, and retains first selected reason without stage/caller abort.
An acquisition already admitted before parent close is covered: eventual cooperative resource is released exactly once before parent/public registered cleanup settles.
Parent cleanup cannot resolve while registered child or grandchild cleanup is gated; no transient child removal loses the transitive drain.
Cleanup was registered synchronously before resource admission, shares idempotent finally completion, and does not wait for unrelated opaque work.
Outside-tree file bytes and stderr complete exactly; no implicit global-stage cancellation or test-side manual propagation masquerades as product behavior.
bindingBlockers: Declared explicit parent-child API and transitive admission/drain contract
Observable cooperative acquisition with VFS-backed owned resource and exact reason mapping

cases.name: Child output close isolates its parent, sibling and independent effects
cases.distinctFromOld: The closed operation has an explicit parent and an explicitly related sibling; survival is not just two unrelated operations.
workflow: In actual Shell, create a parent not bound to stdout, then a stdout-bound child and a file sibling under that parent.
Start one stdout-child owned read before releasing head; retain parent and sibling cooperative work behind independent gates.
Observe child output-close cleanup; only afterward admit fresh parent and sibling work and release their gates.
Complete both exact VFS files and independent stderr, then explicitly close the parent normally and verify final resource accounting.
required: Child sees output-close EPIPE and releases exactly once; parent, sibling, stage and caller are not aborted by that event.
Fresh parent/sibling acquisition after child close succeeds, with proper registration before acquisition; surviving flags alone are insufficient.
Parent and sibling exact file bytes and stderr are produced after child closure, with no writes to the closed stdout sink.
Closing the parent at the end cannot duplicate the already closed child's cleanup; registered resource accounting is complete.
bindingBlockers: Parent scope construction independent of stdout plus child destination binding
Exact normal-close versus downstream-close reason/status distinction

cases.name: Active borrowed curl input survives for required mixed destinations
cases.distinctFromOld: H09-H11 exercised mixed destinations without requiring curl already blocked on a borrowed data read at output closure.
workflow: Run the frozen real curl data/body-file/header-file/writeout argv through Shell against one explicitly allowed task-owned loopback endpoint.
Deliver the first upload chunk and hold the second borrowed next pending; release downstream only after that actual read enters, before response headers and first stdout write.
Observe stdout closure and verify request/file ownership remains admitted; release the second input chunk and real EOF, then send the deterministic response with automatic Date disabled.
Complete independent VFS/stderr work outside the stdout operation and retain actual upload, response header bytes, body file and all diagnostics.
Observe actual request/socket finish/close before forced harness teardown; record necessary completion separately from cancellation of redundant stdout writeout.
required: Borrowed source return/cancel/close is zero even when curl finishes or writeout encounters the closed output; this run intentionally supplies the full finite upload to curl.
Exactly one real HTTP request receives the complete frozen upload; stdout closure must not prevent request start merely because curl buffers data before networking.
Body file equals the exact response bytes and header file equals the frozen header block; no partial file or missing preheaders work is acceptable.
Independent file and stderr bytes complete exactly, stage/caller remain live at closure, and stdout stays empty.
Keep any legitimate late-write diagnostic/status exactly as declared before execution; do not suppress errors to pass, or broaden old H09-H11 status assertions.
Actual loopback owned-resource cleanup is demonstrated; a mock transport only is insufficient for this case.
bindingBlockers: Exact curl option spelling from authenticated public declaration and output-status policy
Declared header serialization and transport request-cleanup registration; deterministic header mismatch cannot silently rebaseline input

cases.name: Borrowed late errors and child cleanup preserve caller/error precedence
cases.distinctFromOld: H12 supplied precedence controls; this adds a still-pending borrowed next and explicitly parented cooperative cleanup failure without changing those controls.
workflow: Run exactly the four frozen subruns through actual Shell with a started opaque borrowed next, output-close barrier and explicitly registered child cleanup.
For caller variants abort with the same object or primitive zero before selected public settlement; resolve the pending read and release failing cooperative cleanup under explicit gates.

For execution/aggregate variants retain sentinel error identities, release registered cleanup, and reject the controlled opaque read after its consumer has stopped waiting (after public settlement when the declared contract permits).

Use bounded process-level unhandled-rejection observation and then a real owner consumer in a separate live Shell invocation without the aborted caller signal for the survivor bytes; drain all controlled gates before leaving.
required: Observed caller reason wins by exact identity including primitive zero and errno-shaped EPIPE; internal child output-close is not caller cancellation.
Selected execution rejection survives cleanup errors; without caller/execution rejection, both child cleanup errors appear by identity in the public aggregate.
Every registered cooperative cleanup is awaited once and every late rejection is observed; no unhandled rejection or invented generic success/cancellation status.
Borrowed iterator return/cancel remains zero, the actual late read is not falsely labeled preempted, and exact owner survivor bytes remain usable.
Four subruns form one logical case; a missing subrun is incomplete, never four extra passes.
bindingBlockers: Exact public error-selection points and parent-child cleanup registration
Truthful late opaque-read observation without enrolling opaque work in cooperative cleanup
